chapters.name: Multiplication Properties and Strategies
chapters.title: Chapter 5: Multiplication Properties and Strategies
chapters.summary: Lessons 5-1 to 5-7: break apart facts to multiply by 3, 4, 6, 7, 8 and 9.

chapters.name: Connect Area and Multiplication
chapters.title: Chapter 6: Connect Area and Multiplication
chapters.summary: Lessons 6-1 to 6-6: find area by tiling, counting, multiplying and splitting shapes.

lessons.title: Understand the Distributive Property
lessons.summary: Decompose a fact into two easier facts, then add.

lessons.title: Use Properties to Multiply by 3
lessons.summary: A 3s fact is a 2s fact plus a 1s fact.

lessons.title: Use Properties to Multiply by 4
lessons.summary: A 4s fact is double the 2s fact.

lessons.title: Use Properties to Multiply by 6
lessons.summary: Use the 5s fact and add one more group, or double the 3s fact.

lessons.title: Use Properties to Multiply by 8
lessons.summary: Double the 4s fact, or add the 5s fact and the 3s fact.

lessons.title: Use Properties to Multiply by 7 and 9
lessons.summary: Start with a 5s fact. Add the 2s fact for 7s, or the 4s fact for 9s.

lessons.title: Solve Multiplication Problems
lessons.summary: Find the equal groups, write the fact, and use a strategy to solve.

lessons.title: Understand Area
lessons.summary: Cover a shape with unit squares, no gaps and no overlaps, and count them.

lessons.title: Count Unit Squares to Determine Area
lessons.summary: Count unit squares in rows and columns, and name the area with its unit.

lessons.title: Use Multiplication to Determine Area
lessons.summary: Multiply the length and the width of a rectangle.

lessons.title: Determine the Area of a Composite Figure
lessons.summary: Split a figure into rectangles, find each area, and add.

lessons.title: Use the Distributive Property to Determine Area
lessons.summary: Break a side into two parts, find both areas, and add (Chapter 5 strategy).

lessons.title: Solve Area Problems
lessons.summary: Solve real-world area problems and label the answer in square units.
